messages:
Priya R: quick sync — hotpath sprint wrapup snag. We hit higher tail latency on continuous-batching canary after kv-lru change. Root cause suspected race on kv warmup. Can owners confirm last deploy + timeline? @Sam T @Louis K :eyes:
Sam T: saw the alerts. digging. can confirm batch qps stable but p95 spiked ~80ms -> 140ms after deploy at 02:14 UTC
Louis K: canary logs show repeated "kv-miss" thrash and new warmup goroutine churn. adding sample logs:
Louis K: ```
[2026-03-16T02:14:23Z] INFO kv: miss key=slot_42 warmup_spawned=true
[2026-03-16T02:14:23Z] WARN batch: backpressure=true active_batches=27
```
Priya R: thanks. Sam, which kernel PR landed the kv change? link? also what metrics to look at for regression tests
Sam T: PR #4891 merged by me — changed KV warmup backoff and added prefetch window. link: https://git.redwood/infra/pr/4891
Sam T: metric: kv_warmup_rate, kv_miss_rate, batch_active_count, token_latency_p50/p95
Nora M: from runtime side, the continuous-batching coordinator assumes idempotent warmup; new spawn logic may duplicate cache fills. Could we gate warmup with a single-flight? I can throw up a patch that uses inflight map.
Louis K: single-flight sounds good. quick patch idea:
Louis K: ```go
// pseudo
if !inflight.Add(key) { return }
go func(){ fillCache(key); inflight.Done(key) }()
```
Priya R: timeline: we need a mitigation before EOD. Options: rollback PR 4891, patch single-flight, or tune prefetch window to 0.5x. Which is fastest?
Sam T: fastest = tune prefetch to 0.5x (config change). rollback will impact other perf gains. patch needs review.
Priya R: Louis can you test 0.5x on canary and report delta on p95 within 30m?
Louis K: on it, kicking canary job now: /deploy canary-kv-0.5x
devops-bot: Deploy started: canary-kv-0.5x — build 2026.3.16-22
Louis K: initial results after 12m: p95 down from 140ms -> 95ms, kv_miss_rate down 18%. Still above baseline 80ms.
Nora M: ok that suggests warmup duplication partially to blame. I can prototype single-flight and run on bench cluster tomorrow morning.
Sam T: I'll open a small PR to expose prefetch multiplier as runtime flag so we can iterate without deploy rollbacks. PR #4902
Priya R: great. action items: Louis finish canary run and post final stats (deadline 60m), Sam expose flag PR, Nora prototype single-flight, Sam/Louis coordinate on telemetry dash update. I'll ping product if the customer-facing SLA risk increases.
Louis K: posted final: p95 90ms, kv_miss_rate -22%, active_batches -12%. marking canary as improved but not fully recovered. Recommend merging flag exposure then Nora's single-flight patch next.
Sam T: ack. I'll update the rollout plan in the epic: https://sprints.redwood/epic/serving-hotpath-2026Q1
Priya R: thanks everyone :thumbsup: Closing this thread once PRs are up. If anyone sees regressions, @here flag it.
